description: This file defines constants, inline functions, and macros for interacting with the ARM architecture timer on Cortex-A R processors within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes timer initialization, setting compare values, enabling/disabling the timer, and handling timer interrupts, with specific support for certain errata.

methods.name: arm_arch_timer_init
methods.description: Initializes the ARM architecture timer by mapping its memory region.

methods.name: arm_arch_timer_set_compare
methods.description: Sets the compare register for the timer to trigger at a specific 64-bit value.

methods.name: arm_arch_timer_get_int_status
methods.description: Returns the interrupt status flag for the timer, used for specific erratum workaround.

methods.name: arm_arch_timer_clear_int_status
methods.description: Clears the timer interrupt status flag.

methods.name: arm_arch_timer_set_irq_mask
methods.description: Masks or unmasks the timer interrupt.

methods.name: arm_arch_timer_count
methods.description: Reads the current 64-bit global timer counter value.
